newsitem.title: USA: Alliant Techsystems gets $1 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Alliant Techsystems gets $1 mln contract.

text.p: Alliant Techsystems Inc said Wednesday it won a $1 million contract to continue development of advanced composite technology for bridge infrastructure.
Included in the contract is the design and manufacture of filament-wound graphite fiber shells to be used in a highway bridge near Palm Springs, Calif.
The California Transit Authority is scheduled to begin construction of the medium-span modular bridge in the fall of 1997.
The contract was awarded to Alliant's Aerospace Systems Group by the U.S. government's Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency.
Alliant is an aerospace and defense company.
